output.reason: A 24-year-old with an inversion basketball injury, lateral ankle swelling and bruising who can still bear some weight has a presentation compatible with a simple sprain, and self-care with a clear action-based safety net is sufficient on the reported facts.
output.patientMessage: You can manage this at home for now: rest it, ice, use a compression wrap, and keep it elevated, taking weight through it only as comfort allows. Your ability to bear some weight makes a straightforward sprain likely. Get checked in person if you cannot bear weight at all, pain or swelling worsens sharply, or you develop numbness, coldness or pallor in the foot.
